title: Crypto Trading Signals - April 22, 2026
top_story_headline: U.S. bitcoin ETFs recorded $238.37 million in net inflows on Monday, marking a fifth straight day of gains. BlackRock’s IBIT led with $256.05 million, while Ether ETFs extended an eight-day streak by adding $67.77 million. Despite some outflows from Grayscale, total bitcoin ETF net assets reached a significant $100.33 billion.
top_story_comment: Institutions stacking sats while ETH ETFs pull pennies. Few understand the real money is still flowing into Bitcoin, as it should be. Tick tock next block.
